story.title: My Story
story.description: I’m a 19-year-old coder who loves turning ideas into code. Web apps are my #1, whether it’s front-end or back-end. I’m all about self-improvement, healthy living, and constantly learning new tech to take my projects to the next level. And when I’m not coding, you might catch me slaying monsters in The Witcher or Skyrim.
